title: Ruuhu muñɗo e galle ceniɗo
intro: E nder kelle Quraan, limre yaltata ko e leñol annabi mawɗo, rokkaama dokkal e mawngu. Ooɗoo ruuhu ina mawninee sabu goonga mo ustataako e darnde mum luggiɗnde e sosde nokku ceniɗo mo wonata lampa gooŋɗinal. No njanngir-ɗaa nate ɗee nii, keɗo-ɗaa no moƴƴi daande nde ummorii ko e yontaaji ɓennuɗi, sibu nde haaldata ko e neɗɗo gadano.
clues: Mi siftinaama e nder Quraan e sara annabi goɗɗo, ko dokkal rokkaangal nulaaɗo mawɗo.
Miɗo jeyaa e ɓiɓɓe ɗiɗo ndokkaaɓe oon annabi e duuɓi mum cakkitiiɗi ɗii.
Miɗo yetta e nder Quraan sabu ko mi gooŋɗinɗo haala am.
Mi nawdi teddungal annabaagal, mi neldaama nulaaɗo.
Mi hawri e baaba am e ƴellitde sosiyeteeji Galle Ceniicfo.
Miɗo siftora wonde gooto e muñɓe, galle ceniɗo mo min mbaɗi oo wonti nokku ngartam e kisal yimɓe.
arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
